corrections.critique: Strongest feature: Hawkins confronts the branching-future objection by distinguishing agential sourcehood from objectively diverging actuality and locating alternative possibilities among relevantly comparable worlds, answering Folley’s deterministic pressure. Principal limitation: His comparability criterion remains insufficiently articulated, because leaving unspecified which circumstances, laws, reasons, and characteristics remain invariant risks manufacturing alternatives by modifying what explains the actual decision. Live burden: Hawkins must provide a principled similarity standard demonstrating that admissible counterfactual worlds preserve enough of the agent’s motivational and nomological situation to represent genuine ability rather than metaphysical redescription. Locked score: The strong/competent 75–84 band recognizes burden contact and intelligible sourcehood while withholding higher credit for unresolved modal constraints, unstable terminology, implicit qualification, and moderately secured warrant.
